distinctEconomicMechanism: USD-quoted FX peers may transmit broad dollar shocks with incomplete one-to-two-hour adjustment across concurrently open liquid markets; test whether historically lagging cross catches up after closed H1 signals. Falsifiable; not an assumption of tradable latency or profit.

chronology.maturity: entry and exit proxy must remain inside the phase

causality.time: decision at completion of original H1 candle t
causality.features: only completed H1 closes at t and prior; 24 contiguous H1 hourly returns for target, at least two contiguous preceding H1 peer returns; never fill missing hours
causality.priceScale: Original Open API ProtoOA GetTrendbars low and deltas are price units multiplied by 100000; original integer prices preserved and no invented BID/ASK
causality.entry: next original H1 OPEN at t+1h, proxy no executable fill
causality.exit: H1 CLOSE of t+2h, 2h price-only holding; all clock intervals must be contiguous
causality.censoring: missing features, gaps, maturity or settlement conversion recorded; no unknown future may select a signal

hypothesis.peerGrouping: two other USD-quoted FX majors; all price changes have comparable USD-quote orientation
hypothesis.peer2h: median of peers individual last 2h log returns
hypothesis.targetSigma: RMS of target last 24 hourly log returns; no information after decision
hypothesis.consensus: both peers same nonzero 2h return sign
hypothesis.eventPeerStrength: absolute median peer2h return > 1.5 * sqrt(2) * target past24 hourly RMS
hypothesis.targetLag: absolute target last2h log return < 0.5 * absolute peer2h median
hypothesis.lastHourOpposition: no strong target last-hour opposing shock: signed target last1h return >= -0.5*target RMS
hypothesis.direction: sign of median peer2h log return

selection.policy: one globally pooled signal family over all three predeclared instruments; no per-symbol rescue
selection.training: train phase only freezes direction policy admission if commission-only 1000-unit EUR mean positive and above matched target-momentum comparator, both weekly lower 95% (t fixed 2.179 for 12df when 13 weeks; train uses 26week t=2.060 for 25df), at least 8 weeks with signals; otherwise selection action ABSTAIN. Independently report all counterfactual signal outcomes regardless admission; no modification after scoring
selection.outcome: signed EUR close proxy and sign accuracy, gross and commission-only; compare matched target momentum, always long, and cash
selection.positiveClaim: NO full-net claim without historical spread/commission/swap/slippage/FX bid-ask; commission-only is optimistic bound, not funded EUR NET

finance.settlement: model USD price P&L converted by actual completed contemporaneous H1 EURUSD-close price proxy; not broker FX execution quote
finance.costLimitations: historical BID/ASK, possible financing, minimum all-in spread, FX conversion execution and slippage absent; full NET null, not a financed or executable 300EUR portfolio

inference.weeklyBlocks: calendar ISO weeks, no bar-level independence claim; report all 26/13/13 weeks including zero-signal weeks
inference.selectionThreshold: weekly mean incremental commission-only EUR over matched momentum and cash >0 with 95% lower CI, ex-post exposed purely descriptive and not promotion
inference.multipleTesting: one predeclared global policy, no selective instrument ranking, all three reported
